title: Wall hook with back plate
prompt: Wall hook. Back plate: 30 mm wide x 60 mm tall x 4 mm thick, in the XZ plane with its back on Y = 0, bottom edge on Z = 0, centred on X; two 4.5 mm screw holes on the vertical centreline at 10 mm and 50 mm height. Hook arm: 10 mm wide, centred on the plate. It sticks straight out from the front of the plate (8 mm tall, bottom at 20 mm height) to 38 mm from the wall, with the outside bottom corner rounded (R8), and turns up into a lip 8 mm thick that rises to 36 mm height.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Two bodies: back plate and arm
30 wide, sticks out 38 mm from the wall, 60 tall
Back on Y = 0, centred on X, bottom on Z = 0
Screw holes through the plate on the centreline at 10 and 50 mm height
The back plate: 30 x 60 x 4 mm with its two holes
The arm: 10 wide, from the plate front (Y = 4) to Y = 38, Z from 20 to 36
